text:
jess_procurement: NordicCompute just flagged an import license snag for our FRA H100 shipment. ETA shift ~3-4wks. They've proposed two options: (A) expedite 20 units by air now and sea the rest, or (B) swap up to 20% for A100s at -15% list. Need decision by EOD CET.
liam_sre: Current eu-west-1 edge pools are strained — about 10% headroom. If we airlift 20 units we cover peak, otherwise we need routing changes. What's air premium?
jess_procurement: Air uplift quote: +20% per unit. Carrier broker fee 50/unit. Sea-only reduces uplift to +5% but adds 2-3wks. Vendor will pre-assign AWBs if we confirm.
anya_logistics: Depot note: FRA depot blocks incoming AWBs without PO on the airwaybill. If we split, need separate AWBs and manifest updates. We can stage partial arrival in FRA for RMA reconciliation but need prepaid return labels for DOAs to avoid hold.
sam_infra: If we accept A100 swap for up to 16 units, perf delta: p95 latency up ~10% for some workloads but throughput remains fine. We can reroute non-latency-sensitive batch jobs there. Ops-bot: "gpu-queue" alerts trending up 2.4x — delaying some retrains helps.
liam_sre: Proposed mitigation plan: 1) Accept A100 swap for 16 units and route to canary compute pool; 2) Approve air for 12 critical H100s to cover SLA traffic spikes; 3) Sea remainder and reserve 30 FRA depot slots for RMA staging.
jess_procurement: I'll push vendor for cap on air uplift (target +12%) and to waive broker fee if we accept phased sea. Also asking for prepaid RMA labels and separate AWBs per depot requirement.
finance_bot: Budget note: air option at +20% will require an addl budget approval ~5k. Approving up to +14% can be auto-approved by finance.
anya_logistics: Vendor sent sample manifest:
```
AWB: ND-987654321
PO: RW-2025-110
SKU: H100-900GB x64 (split: 12 air, 52 sea)
PrepaidRMA: yes
```
sam_infra: Ops question: can we hot-swap a100 jobs without code changes? Yes, runtime handles device selection; we'll add model-slicing flags.
liam_sre: I'll update the runbooks and temporary throttles. Also request that vendor provides serial list immediately for pre-clearance.
jess_procurement: Decision checkpoint: if vendor agrees to waive broker fee and cap air uplift at +14%, we accept: A100 swap 16 units, air 12 H100s, sea remainder. Approve?
sam_infra: approve.
liam_sre: +1. I'll handle routing and monitoring changes.
anya_logistics: I'll confirm AWBs and book depot slots, and request prepaid return labels. Will post final manifest and AWBs when received.
finance_bot: Noted. Holding auto-release until vendor confirms uplift cap.
ops-bot: deployment-bot: scheduling throughput throttles at 02:00 UTC and canary routing change at 03:00 UTC.
